notes.title: Catgirl & Doggirl Cafe - Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you've all enjoyed your first few days with Catgirl & Doggirl Cafe! We noticed that when you change the setting for enabling/disabling the X-Ray images it wasn't working correctly, this update fixes that as well as fixing some spelling and grammar issues. 

If you haven't already, please consider purchasing Catgirl and Doggirl Cafe while it is still 20% off for the first week after its launch.
